narrative.details: The soul of the fallen clings to that which represents its former life and transforms the item into a soulbound keepsake. You pick the item up and place it in your pack.
narrative.objectives: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText: As the soul clung to the keepsake, so shall it cling to the physical form of Ras Frostwhisper.
